name: r5fs7y-quota-pill-wording
goal: Header quota pills show both Claude and Codex; 0% reads OUT OF QUOTA with the Lisbon reset; ALMOST OUT only under 10%; hover/tap explains each limit

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Header pill reads 'Almost out Codex Weekly 0% left' (HubHomeHeader.svelte renders only lowestLimit; warningFor treats 0 as critical). Expected (Daniel notes 18:31): both Claude (5h, weekly) and Codex (weekly) pills; 0% = OUT OF QUOTA + Lisbon reset; ALMOST OUT only under 10%; hover/tap explains the limit.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: No standardized test read the header quota pill: hub-home specs asserted only the card callout and dialog, and hub-home-fixture-quota never had a 0% limit. Added the standard quota spec hub-home-quota.spec.ts (two-subscription fixture, 0/1/9/10% and missing/stale boundaries, phone + laptop, hover/tap, callout spacing) and extended hub-home-presentation.test.ts (Lisbon summer reset, unknown/due reset, model limits, out-of-quota summary).

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase red failed at the test-only commit: every case in hub-home-quota.spec.ts fails on the unfixed build (header shows 'Almost out Codex Weekly 0% left', no 'Subscription quota' list).

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: hubQuotaPills.ts + HubHomeQuotaPills.svelte: one pill per subscription; warningLabel says Out of quota at 0; lowSummary words the card badge and dialog; .hh-q-preview gap.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase green passed the unchanged hub-home-quota.spec.ts at the fix commit.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
